messages:
leah_sales: FYI prospective POC with EuroBank next week. they want a guarantee: "no data leaves EU during POC window". they also want list of subprocessors and a quick cost delta if we must guarantee it.

sam_presales: short: hosted can be EU-affinity but not absolute. Dedicated or Private required for contractual guarantee. call out monitoring/logs and backups as common egress points.

maria_security: +1. We can provide an attestation for subprocessors and our DR posture. but for contractual EU-only we need to escalate to legal. BYOK/encryption custody will be required if they insist.

ryan_ops: ops note: we can create a temporary tenant pinned to eu-west-1 and disable cross-region backups for the POC window, but that still leaves third-party telemetry (monitoring/logging) unless we switch to EU-only vendors. we can run a short lived dedicated pool if decision made today.

sam_presales: suggested scoping snippet for customer doc: ```json
{"environment":"hosted-eu-affinity","guarantee":"soft","subprocessors":["AWS eu-west-1","CloudMetrics-EU","LogStream-EU"],"strict_option":"Dedicated/Private required for contractual EU-only"}
```

maria_security: Legal wants plain language: "During the POC we will process and store data within EU regions. Hosted accounts will have EU affinity; backups, monitoring, or analytics may be processed outside EU unless Dedicated or Private deployment is purchased. A formal attestation of subprocessors will be provided."

leah_sales: customer also asked for a ballpark uplift for Dedicated for a 30-day POC (20 seats). any quick numbers?

ryan_ops: rough: Dedicated uplift ~20-35% over hosted baseline for short-term reservation, depends on instance types and GPU count. will confirm with infra.

infra_bot: export ready: /s3/exports/eurobank_poc/subprocessors_2026-03-19.csv (contains vendor contacts and SCC references).

leah_sales: great. i'll attach infra export to scoping doc and request draft attestation from legal. will push pricing draft after infra confirms GPU sizing. thanks team. :thumbsup:

maria_security: flagging: if customer requires contract clause, legal will want to add SLA + audit right and BYOK clause. that may delay signoff.

sam_presales: noted. next steps: leah to share scoping doc + infra export; maria to engage legal for attestation & clause; ryan to confirm dedicated cost estimate. follow up here once done.
